cover: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Query Plan Analysis: Reading the Salesforce Optimizer Like an Architect'. Deep dark navy background with glowing neon blue header. Subtitle 'SOQL selectivity, indexes, cardinality, and architecture decisions at scale'. Top row cards: 'Relative Cost' with speedometer icon, 'Cardinality' with database rows icon, 'Leading Operation' with query execution icon. Middle section shows side-by-side query plan table: LEFT red-themed 'NONSELECTIVE PLAN' with TableScan, Cost 4.82, Cardinality 8.7M; RIGHT green-themed 'SELECTIVE PLAN' with Index, Cost 0.11, Cardinality 42K. Center code panels show bad SOQL filtering by CreatedDate only and good SOQL filtering by Status__c + Region__c + External_Id__c. Bottom checklist: 'Design filters before code', 'Use compound selectivity', 'Validate against real data volume'. Circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. Razor-sharp neon text, grid lines, monospace code, high contrast.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'SOQL Query Plan Review Workflow'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header. Subtitle 'How architects validate optimizer behavior before production scale'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — '1. Capture SOQL with bind values' with code icon, '2. Run REST explain on API v64.0' with terminal icon, '3. Record relative cost and cardinality' with chart icon. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD REVIEW' with red DANGER pill showing code `SELECT Id FROM Case WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:180 LIMIT 50`; RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD REVIEW' with green SUCCESS pill showing code `SELECT Id FROM Case WHERE Status = 'New' AND Origin = 'Email' AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 LIMIT 100`. CENTER: query plan table with rows 'TableScan cost 4.82 cardinality 8700000' crossed out and 'Index cost 0.11 cardinality 42000' highlighted. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Check leadingOperationType', 'Compare cardinality to table size', 'Validate with production-like data'. Footer bar: 'No query plan, no scale claim'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'SOQL Scale Behavior: 1K vs 100K vs 10M'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header. Subtitle 'Why query plans become architecture decisions'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — '1K Records: table scans hide problems' with small database icon, '100K Records: selectivity starts to matter' with warning chart icon, '10M Records: architecture dominates' with skyscraper database icon. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD SCALE PATTERN' with red DANGER pill and code `SELECT Id FROM Order_Event__c WHERE Event_Status__c = 'Processed'`; RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD SCALE PATTERN' with green SUCCESS pill and code `SELECT Id FROM Order_Event__c WHERE Event_Status__c = 'Failed' AND Processing_Region__c = 'APAC' AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7`. CENTER: graph line showing relative cost rising from 0.05 to 4.8 for broad filter, and staying under 0.2 for selective filter. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Model access patterns', 'Measure cardinality', 'Archive cold data'. Footer bar: 'Small data lies. Query plans tell the truth.'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.
